labels.criterion_text: Patients with DM type 2 of more than 1-year duration
labels.reason: Type 2 diabetes is supported by the documented diabetes diagnosis and type 2 diabetic neuropathy. Diabetes onset was 2019-10-18, more than two years before the 2021-11-30 reference date.
The protocol says DM stage 3 or less, but does not specify the diabetes staging system. No corresponding diabetes stage is documented.
missing_information: Definition of the DM staging system and documented patient stage.
labels.review_notes: Protocol ambiguity: do not substitute CKD staging or infer a diabetes stage from complications.

labels.reason: The patient was 27 years old at the reference date, meeting the minimum age of 18 years.

labels.criterion_text: Refractory painful diabetic peripheral neuropathy of the lower extremities
labels.reason: Type 2 diabetic neuropathy is documented. A pain score of 4/10 was recorded in 2019, but the record does not establish lower-extremity localization, neuropathic pain attribution, or refractory pain despite treatment.
missing_information: Treatment history and evidence of refractory pain.
labels.review_notes: Documented diabetic neuropathy is insufficient to establish refractory painful lower-extremity neuropathy.

labels.reason: An ankle-brachial index below 0.9 is not documented or contradicted by a measured ABI.
Current anticoagulant treatment is neither affirmatively documented nor explicitly ruled out.
A previous episode of acute viral pharyngitis in August 2020 was documented as resolved, but the presence or absence of an active infection at the reference date is not established.
The latest documented HbA1c was 6.6% on 2019-10-18, below the protocol exclusion threshold of 10%.
labels.review_notes: Interpreted protocol shorthand HbA1 >10 as an HbA1c threshold.

labels.reason: Stress and social isolation are documented, but these findings do not independently establish a qualifying psychiatric disorder or cognitive dysfunction. Their absence is also not established.
missing_information: Qualifying psychiatric diagnosis or cognitive-function assessment.
labels.review_notes: Stress and social isolation are not automatically psychiatric diagnoses.

labels.reason: A confirmed drug-misuse finding began in 2016 and remains recorded as active, supported by a DAST-10 score of 7. Under the agreed broad interpretation of illicit drug usage as nonmedical drug misuse, the exclusion criterion is met.
labels.review_notes: Human-confirmed broad interpretation of illicit drug usage. Drug misuse and DAST-10 score support nonmedical drug misuse, but do not identify a specific legally illicit substance. The condition's recorded active status is not independent proof of use on the reference date.

labels.reason: Current dialysis treatment is neither confirmed nor explicitly excluded by the available records.
missing_information: Current dialysis or renal replacement therapy status.

labels.reason: The latest documented BMI was 26.75 kg/m2 on 2019-10-18, below the exclusion threshold of greater than 35.0.
The available records do not establish whether surgery occurred within the 30 days before the reference or enrollment date.
missing_information: Complete surgical history during the preceding 30 days.

labels.reason: Lower-extremity ulcers are neither confirmed nor explicitly ruled out.
missing_information: Current lower-extremity ulcer examination or diagnosis.
